jobs.title: Environmental Scientist
jobs.description:
**Job Overview:**

APTIM is seeking a motivated entry-level Environmental Scientist to support our portfolio of federal environmental investigation and remediation projects. Projects commonly involve the investigation and remediation of sites with groundwater or soil impacted by chlorinated solvents, petroleum, radiological contaminants, or emerging compounds. The successful candidate will work under the supervision of project managers and partner with other engineers, scientists, geologists, risk assessors, and health physicists.

**Key Responsibilities/Accountabilities:**

* Assist with the collection, documentation, and organization of field data to support project objectives.
* Contribute to the preparation of project work plans and deliverables.
* Assist with the development of technical scopes of work and cost estimates for proposal efforts.
* Develop and maintain spreadsheets, dashboards, and data-tracking tools.
* Assist in the management, analysis, and interpretation of environmental data using statistical analysis and data visualization tools.
* Identify and evaluate environmental risks and recommend remediation strategies to support compliance with federal, state, and local regulations.
* Adhere to established health and safety policies and procedures and execute work in a safe and conscientious manner.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in environmental science or a related scientific discipline (completed or in progress).
* Relevant internship, research, or academic project experience involving environmental investigation, water or wastewater treatment, sustainability, or ecological conservation (0–2 years).
* Strong interest in environmental remediation, field investigations, treatment systems, and environmental compliance.
* Must have strong written and oral communication skills.
* Willingness to learn field sampling methods, equipment operation, and environmental data collection procedures.
* Ability to perform essential field duties, including walking on uneven terrain, lifting and carrying field equipment, and working outdoors in varying weather conditions.
* Ability to wear and use required PPE.
* Ability to travel to work sites, including overnight travel.
* Valid driver's license.
* Must be a U.S. citizen or authorized to work on federal contracts.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Completion of 40-hour OSHA HAZWOPER training.
* Experience using AI tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, or similar tools) to support technical communication, analytical tasks, research, and efficient project execution. Upon hire, employees are expected to use these tools in accordance with approved company guidelines.

**About APTIM**

APTIM enhances the quality of the environment, wellbeing of people, resilience of communities, and opportunity for employees to make a difference, not just a living. A leading professional solutions firm, we specialize in environmental, sustainability, resilience, and infrastructure solutions. Our team of experts provide these integrated solutions for forward-thinking government agencies, commercial and industrial clients, and energy customers. Together, we create sustainable and resilient communities for all.

What you can expect from APTIM:

* Work that is worthy of your time and talent
* Respect and flexibility to live a full life at work and at home
* Dogged determination to deliver for our clients and communities
* A voice in making our company better
* Investment into your personal and professional development

As of the date of this posting, a good faith estimate of the current pay range for this position is $36.00 to $40.00 per hour. Compensation depends on several factors including: experience, education, key skills, geographic location of the position, client requirements, external market competitiveness, and internal equity among other employees within APTIM.

**Employee Benefits**

APTIM Federal Services, llc is committed to providing an extensive range of benefits that protect and promote the health and financial well-being of our employees and their families through the APTIM Benefits Marketplace https://aptim.makeityoursource.com/.

* Medical, vision, and dental insurance: Through the marketplace, our employees can choose benefits from five metallic levels and several carriers to find the right benefits that work for them in their location.
* Company paid and optional Life insurance
* Short-term and long-term disability insurance
* Accident, Critical Illness, and Hospital Indemnity coverage
* Paid holidays, vacation, and sick leave (eligibility based on company policy and applicable law)
* 401(k) APTIM offers three 401k plans through the Aon Pooled Employer Plan (PEP). The specific plan you are eligible for depends on the business unit you are in. The details of the largest plan are found here:

* + APTIM 401(k) Guide
  + APTIM - Helpful Documents

jobs.title: Service Center Supervisor- Eurofins Drinking Water and Wastewater West, Bend, OR
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

Eurofins Scientific is a network of independent companies providing a unique range of analytical testing  
services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic, and labelling is accurate.

Eurofins is dedicated to delivering testing services that contribute to the health and safety of society and the planet, and to its corporate responsibility to protect the environment and ensure diversity, equity, and inclusion across the entire network of Eurofins companies.

With over 50 laboratories and more than 40 service centers nationwide, Eurofins Environment Testing provides full-service environmental analysis across all 50 states. Our network supports public and private clients—including DoD, DOE, and municipalities—through robust logistics and continuous investment in people, technology, and infrastructure. We offer comprehensive testing for air, water, soil, sediment, tissue, and waste, covering a wide range of analytes including PFAS, metals, VOCs/SVOCs, dioxins/furans, radiochemicals, and more.

 **Job Description**

Eurofins Drinking Water and Wastewater West is seeking a Service Center Supervisor to join our team in Bend OR!

**Responsibilities**

* Oversee all activities and employees of the location
* Project management of all received samples and projects as needed
* Analyze microbiology and inorganic testing on potable and non-potable water samples
* Perform monthly environmental testing (water, surfaces, air) and annual calibrations
* Receive and log potable water and non-potable water samples from clients
* Create microbiological and chemical projects and reports and corresponding invoices
* Prepare various media types for sample analysis
* Submit all compliance drinking water to Oregon State Heath Authority and EPA as needed
* Answer and respond to all client correspondence via phone and email
* Schedule all equipment calibration and maintain diligent records
* Schedule all sample collections performed by the location
* Consult public on testing and sampling procedures
* Consult water systems and utilities on testing and sampling procedures
* Maintain laboratory supply inventory
* Maintain all SOPs and training documents
* Maintain all NELAP certification requirements including but not limited to: proficiency testing, internal audits, logbook audits, on-site audits by accreditation body and audit responses
* Act as onsite Quality Control Officer
* Maintain and organize clients chemical and sampling schedules along with bottle orders and personalized CoCs.
* Ability to analyze samples on weekends, holidays and on call, as needed

  
**Qualifications**

**Skills/Qualifications**

* Aseptic technique
* Excellent customer service
* Reliable, timely and punctual
* Multitasking with strong time management
* Work within strict time requirements of microbiology tests
* Excellent documentation, computer and organization skills
* Must be able to communicate effectively with lab personnel and clients
* Previous knowledge of environmental testing and compliance regulations is desired

**Education/Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in microbiology, biology, or equivalent
* 2 years customer experience preferred
* Minimum of two weeks training at academic institution in microbiological analysis of drinking water or 80 hours on the job training

  
**Additional Information**

Position is full-time salaried, Monday to Friday 8 am to 5 pm with possibility of longer hours and weekends as needed.

**The salary range for this position is $65,000 - $70,000 annually.**

**Candidates within a commutable distance to Bend, OR are encouraged to apply.**

Eurofins Environment Testing (USA) provides a compensation range for informational purposes, the actual base salary may vary based upon, but not limited to, relevant experience and skill set, base salary of internal peers, business sector, and geographic location.

As a Eurofins employee, you will become part of a company that has received national recognition as a great place to work. We offer excellent full-time benefits including comprehensive medical coverage, life and disability insurance, 401(k) with company match, paid holidays, paid time off, and dental and vision options.

**To learn more about Eurofins, please explore our website www.eurofinsus.com**

**We support your development!** Do you feel you don’t match 100% of the requirements? Don’t hesitate to apply anyway! Eurofins companies are committed to supporting your career development.

**We embrace diversity!** Eurofins network of companies believe in strength and innovation through diversity, being an Equal Opportunity Employer. We prohibit discrimination against employees or applications based on gender identity and/or expression, race, nationality, age, religion, sexual orientation, disability, and everything else that makes employees of Eurofins companies unique.

**Sustainability matters to us!** We are well on our way to achieving our objective of carbon neutrality by 2025, through a combination of emission reduction and compensation initiatives. We encourage our laboratory leaders to make sustainable changes at their local level, and in addition to their initiatives we also count on our dedicated carbon reduction team to help us to achieve this goal!
